task_specification.objective: Make all three required release-convergence gaps closure-ready this loop: restore authored cemetery spatial presentation and collision integrity, complete the accessible pause and choice surfaces, and preserve a deterministic, honest dense-profile qualification handoff without fabricating native evidence or replacing preserved authored assets.

diagnosis.root_cause: Release-convergence evidence still shows a west-edge external-world void and zero camera visibility for the mausoleum landmark, while pause ownership has only a partial retest and dense profiling remains correctly rejected because native-renderer qualification is unavailable. The prior world/input implementation did not provide complete cardinal and cross-context closure evidence.

stop_conditions: Do not schedule deferred finding.ordinary_wave_route_incomplete or godot_mcp_rebind_requested.
Do not replace, hide, duplicate, extract, or surgically edit the preserved authored cemetery package or other preserved assets.
Do not claim formal closure, native performance qualification, or runtime screenshot verdicts; those belong to Tester and GameLoop Runtime.
If dense instrumentation already satisfies the requested receipts and release guard, make no speculative gameplay change and leave the native-renderer verdict pending host evidence.

strategy.rationale: Use three bounded root-cause families: rebind camera, world-facing dressing, spawn/navigation, and collision to the intact authored map; finish shell/input ownership together with the mandatory authored upgrade-choice hierarchy; and isolate dense qualification as an honest receipt/guard handoff rather than repeating gameplay tuning. This differs materially from prior transform-only and partial-retest treatments.

code: Run focused static/parser checks for cemetery scene ownership, camera/spatial receipts, InputMap pause uniqueness, shell/choice focus graphs and value predicates, and dense-profile setup/reset self-audit.

Run validate:host_godot_boot and validate:native_godot_project checks plus candidate-local smoke tests for spatial anchors, single Escape pause, choice application-before-resume, and dense receipt lifecycle.
Verify preserved authored package files remain intact and no imported source asset was modified or duplicated.
runtime: Tester/GameLoop Runtime recaptures spawn, critical route, four cardinal landmark/perimeter views, and ordinary movement replay, checking larger traversable scale, external world/depth, central building/landmark visibility, collision, boundary behavior, and absence of disappearance/occlusion drift.

Tester/GameLoop Runtime replays Escape press/hold/release in title, active, pause, and result contexts, exercises context_back independently, and verifies keyboard, mouse, and gamepad pause/choice focus and activation.

visual: Compare shipped-camera recaptures against the bound gameplay reference and failed cells, prioritizing native cemetery streets, central mausoleum/bell landmarks, perimeter continuity, and external depth.
Inspect pause and upgrade-choice pages at the configured native viewport for full-viewport composition, icon/silhouette hierarchy, truthful compact deltas, and distinct focus/hover/pressed states.
Use dense screenshots only to confirm receipt readability; judge performance from runtime telemetry and native qualification evidence, never from a static frame.

Inspect and modify the actual cemetery scene, spatial contract, camera, survival scene, and spawn owners so the playable space is genuinely larger or has a larger traversable scale, the shipped camera sees actual non-playable external world geometry or external depth at the perimeter, and the west void cannot recur.
